'''Fett Stormtroopers, stormtroopers, everywhere!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fett]]
* '''Published:''' 11 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)|Hoth-D-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Hoth Defensive Perimeter (3rd Mar Stormtro.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a deck using mosty (v) stormtroopers, and all the great cards that are used by troopers!

== Strategy ==

Start with 3rd marker, and my three effects.

The way it breaks down:

AELOMBT  makes my troopers power 4, and my blasters and utility belts are destiny +2, and deploy -1

Crossfire adds 5 to power when blasters are fired

Inconsequential losses allows me to curculate my destiny +2 (total 5) Blaster Rifles and destiny 4 Assault Rifles.

My Interrupts kick tush

Imperial Academy Training adds one to my weapon destiny, and my troopers with weapons add one to battle destiny.

I get a Force Drain bonus at 3rd marker, and a Weapon bonus

Blizzard 1 & 2 are for power and transport.

Tempest Scout 6 deploys for 1 as a react, and moves as a react for free.

Utility Belt has a destiny of 6, and deploys for 0

Squad Leaders move 3 troopers for 1 force

My stormtroopers are destiny 3, and deploy for 1, 0 three times per turn with a probe droid.  They also add one battle destiny with a blaster rifle.

Elite Squadron Troopers are power +2 with a blaster and blasters fire -1

Narthax makes Precise Attack a used interrupt

Major Bursk adds 2 to attrition against opponent.

Probe droids make my imperials deploy -1

Davin Felth is Just cool,

and Gamall Wironicc is power 4, for two force, and my other caracters cannot be targeted.
